comparison: same frozen Entry events, cash, capacity, lot, terminal EXIT, mark, cost and same-time tie

foldStability.definition: only pre-identified folds with >=1 control-funded known row; candidate must also fund >=1 known row; omitted control-zero folds are reported, not counted as positive or negative

metrics.capitalShare: funded known positive entry notional / funded known-label entry notional
metrics.concentration: largest symbol or session funded count / total funded count
metrics.enrichment: funded hitRate / all known Entry candidate hitRate in arm
metrics.foldHitRate: positive funded known within fold / funded known within fold; null if no known funding
metrics.hitRate: positive funded with known label / all funded with known label
metrics.reach: positive funded / all known positive Entry candidates in arm

reproducibility: all 16 fits, prediction identities, score hash, feature hash, ledger hashes, safety all 9 false
selection: 0 PASS -> NO_SELECTION_STOP; one PASS -> SELECT; two PASS -> largest minimum across arms of funded hit rate absolute delta, exact tie -> NO_SELECTION_STOP
